Market today: Rates are the real driver, pushing higher and hurting growth names. Tech/chip exposure on margin means every tick up is a win, but every tick down is amplified pain.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a painful 54.81%, and SPAL is down 57.02%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay, and your margin amplifies these drops. QQQQ, SMH, and QQQI are also in the red and marked SELL.

Watch: Keep an eye on Amazon's earnings today. It's a big tech name, and its results could set the tone.

Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are bleeding, and margin is a dangerous amplifier right now.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming exposure if it breaks below its stop.
SPAL: Consider trimming exposure if it breaks below its stop.
No new buys today - hold and watch
